Cause: The invoice-api 3.8.0 pod spec references a Secret key that doesn't exist. Both new ReplicaSet pods (invoice-api-7c9f8b6d4-hx2lp, -r8wqz) are stuck in CreateContainerConfigError with the message "couldn't find key STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET in Secret billing/invoice-api-secrets". The old 3.7.2 pods are still Running, and invoice-worker is unaffected because it doesn't reference that new key — consistent with 3.8.0 introducing Stripe webhook handling that needs a new env var sourced from the Secret via secretKeyRef.

Evidence: `kubectl get pods -n billing` shows the two 3.8.0 pods in CreateContainerConfigError with the message above; 3.7.2 pods and invoice-worker are Running/ready.

Fix (owner action): Add the `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` key to the `invoice-api-secrets` Secret in the `billing` namespace, e.g. `kubectl -n billing patch secret invoice-api-secrets -p '{"stringData":{"STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET":"<value>"}}'` (or recreate it with --from-literal). Once the key is present, the kubelet will be able to resolve the secretKeyRef and the new pods will start; the rollout will then complete on its own. Each env var sourced from a Secret must match an existing key in that Secret's data [cite: concepts/configuration/secret#using-secrets-as-environment-variables-0] [cite: tasks/inject-data-application/distribute-credentials-secure#define-a-container-environment-variable-with-data-from-a-single-secret-0].
